reproduced.description: The model's claim about whether it reproduced the defect. THE CONTROLLER RE-RUNS THE ARTIFACT AND OVERRIDES THIS -- invariant 2 says a model's self-assessment is discarded and recomputed from the world.

steps.description: How to produce the behaviour. minItems is correct here: a reproduce stage with no steps did no work.

expected.description: What correct behaviour would look like.

artifact.description: A RUNNABLE reproduction. Null is honest when none could be written; invariant 3 caps such a finding at grade B and it can never auto-anything.

content.description: The test or script itself. The CONTROLLER executes this; the stage does not, and holds no shell with which to.

environment.description: Versions, platform, and anything else the reproduction depends on.
